description: End-to-end lifecycle for managing incidents related to RCS business messaging campaigns on a CPaaS/TaaS platform, from detection and triage through mitigation, rollback, and closure.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for an RCS campaign incident

campaign_id.description: RCS campaign or flow identifier associated with the incident

rcs_project_id.description: CPaaS RCS project or tenant identifier

message_batch_id.description: Identifier of a specific RCS message batch or send job

playbook_id.description: Identifier for a predefined incident response playbook

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: detect_rcs_incident
functions.description: Detect or ingest a new RCS messaging incident based on monitoring alerts, delivery anomalies, or manual reports.

rcs_project_id.description: RCS project where the anomaly was detected

detection_payload.description: Raw payload from the detection source

monitor_rule_id.description: If triggered by a monitoring rule

external_ticket_id.description: Reference to customer or carrier ticket

reporter.description: Information about who reported the issue

impacted_scope.description: Scope of impact, such as campaigns, tenants, traffic segments

campaign_ids.description: Candidate campaigns suspected to be impacted

severity_hint.description: Initial guess of severity from detection mechanism

description.description: Free-text summary of the detected issue

functions.returns: New incident_id with initial incident record including detected scope and raw payload reference.

functions.name: get_incident
functions.description: Get full details for a specific RCS incident, including timeline, related entities, and current status.
functions.returns: Incident details including metadata, status, scope, timelines, links to RCS campaigns and monitoring artifacts.

functions.name: list_incidents
functions.description: Search and list RCS incidents with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of incidents and summary metadata (total count, next page token).

functions.name: classify_rcs_incident
functions.description: Classify and update an incident with type, severity, and suspected root cause based on investigation findings.

tags.description: Flexible tags for search and reporting

updated_by.description: User ID who performed the classification

functions.returns: Updated incident record with classification and severity, plus audit metadata.

functions.name: attach_rcs_context
functions.description: Attach additional RCS-specific context to an incident, such as campaign configuration, routes, and sample messages.

rcs_context.description: RCS context to associate with the incident

routes.description: RCS routing paths in use (carrier, region, etc.)

sample_messages.description: Representative sample of impacted RCS messages

replace_existing.description: If true, replaces existing RCS context instead of merging

functions.returns: Incident with updated RCS context, including campaigns, routes, and sampled messages.

functions.name: check_rcs_incident_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current operational status and metrics snapshot for an incident, including live RCS delivery performance.

dimensions.description: Break down metrics by these dimensions

functions.returns: Current high-level incident status plus a metrics snapshot for the requested window and dimensions.

functions.name: plan_rcs_mitigation
functions.description: Plan a mitigation strategy for an RCS incident using predefined playbooks and customizable actions.

playbook_id.description: Predefined playbook to use as a base

custom_plan.description: Optional custom or overriding mitigation plan

halt_or_reroute.description: Define traffic halting or rerouting behavior

campaign_ids.description: If pausing or rerouting selected campaigns

template_adjustments.description: Changes to message templates to reduce rejection/spam

communication_plan.description: How to communicate about the incident

functions.returns: Draft mitigation plan object with resolved playbook steps, ready for execution or approval.

functions.name: apply_rcs_mitigation
functions.description: Execute an approved mitigation plan for an RCS incident, such as pausing campaigns or enabling fallbacks.

mitigation_plan_id.description: Identifier of the prepared mitigation plan

execution_mode.description: Whether to run in dry-run or full execution mode

step_overrides.description: Optional overrides for individual mitigation steps

approval.description: Approval metadata for audit and compliance

functions.returns: Mitigation execution result including per-step status, applied changes, and any failures.

functions.name: rollback_rcs_mitigation
functions.description: Rollback or partially revert an RCS mitigation previously applied for an incident.

mitigation_execution_id.description: Identifier of the mitigation execution to rollback

rollback_scope.description: Which parts of mitigation to rollback

campaign_ids.description: If specified, only rollback for selected campaigns

functions.returns: Rollback execution log including what was reverted, what failed, and follow-up actions if needed.

functions.name: retry_rcs_delivery_for_incident
functions.description: Selectively retry failed or deferred RCS messages associated with an incident, with constraints and safety checks.

status_filter.description: Only retry messages currently in these statuses

error_code_filter.description: Limit retry to specific error codes (e.g., transient)

time_window.description: Only retry messages sent in this time window

max_messages.description: Hard cap on number of messages to retry

safety_checks.description: Safety constraints for the retry job

functions.returns: Retry job identifier and summary of messages selected for retry, plus estimated completion time.

functions.name: update_incident_status
functions.description: Update the lifecycle status of an RCS incident (e.g., move from investigating to monitoring or resolved).

resolution.description: Resolution details, required when marking as resolved or cancelled

status_note.description: Context or reasoning for the status change

functions.returns: Updated incident state including new status, resolution data if applicable, and transition timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_or_merge_incident
functions.description: Cancel an incident that is no longer valid or merge it into another primary incident to avoid duplicates.

merge_target_incident_id.description: Target incident to merge into when action is merge_into

reason.description: Explanation for cancel or merge action

preserve_timeline.description: Whether to keep a read-only stub of the merged/cancelled incident for audit

functions.returns: Confirmation of cancel or merge operation, including updated references and any conflicts encountered.

functions.name: export_incident_report
functions.description: Generate and export a post-incident report for RCS incidents, including metrics, timeline, and RCA summary.

sections.description: Optional selection of sections to include in the report

redaction.description: Redaction rules for PII or sensitive data in the report

custom_redaction_rules.description: Custom regex or field rules to apply during export

delivery.description: How the report should be delivered

functions.returns: Report generation job status and, when available, a download URL or delivery confirmation.

functions.name: search_rcs_incident_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across rcs_incident entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching rcs_incident entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_rcs_incident_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N rcs_incident records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_rcs_incident_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many rcs_incident records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_rcs_incident_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many rcs_incident records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_rcs_incident_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of rcs_incident data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_rcs_incident_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a rcs_incident dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_rcs_incident_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more rcs_incident entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_rcs_incident_snapshot
functions.description: Restore rcs_incident state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_rcs_incident_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the rcs_incident workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_rcs_incident_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across rcs_incident metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_rcs_incident_audit_events
functions.description: Search the rcs_incident audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_rcs_incident_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers rcs_incident workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_rcs_incident_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for rcs_incident events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_rcs_incident_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for rcs_incident events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_rcs_incident_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off rcs_incident job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_rcs_incident_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled rcs_incident jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_rcs_incident_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled rcs_incident job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_rcs_incident_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a rcs_incident operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_rcs_incident_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a rcs_incident action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_rcs_incident_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a rcs_incident approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_rcs_incident_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any rcs_incident entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_rcs_incident_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a rcs_incident entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_rcs_incident_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling rcs_incident behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_rcs_incident_policies
functions.description: List rcs_incident policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_rcs_incident_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two rcs_incident-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_rcs_incident_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a rcs_incident entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_rcs_incident_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many rcs_incident entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
